build_generate_request: build a GenerateReqInput with text, sampling_params, and multimodal image_data for batch inference
normalize_batch_arguments: normalize batch and arguments in GenerateReqInput to expand parallel sampling and unify input formats
create_embedding_request: create an EmbeddingReqInput with text, input_ids, and dimensions for Matryoshka embedding generation
index_tokenized_batch: index and iterate a BatchTokenizedGenerateReqInput to access individual TokenizedGenerateReqInput items
collect_generation_output: collect a BatchStrOutput with finished_reasons, output_strs, logprobs, and speculative decoding metrics
load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter using LoadLoRAAdapterReqInput with lora_name, lora_path, and pinned flag
unload_lora_adapter: unload a LoRA adapter using UnloadLoRAAdapterReqInput with lora_name and lora_id
update_weights_from_disk: update model weights from disk using UpdateWeightFromDiskReqInput with model_path and load_format
update_weights_from_tensor: update model weights from serialized tensors using UpdateWeightsFromTensorReqInput
get_load_metrics: get per-DP-rank load metrics using GetLoadsReqInput with include sections for core, memory, and queues
